verdicts.reason: A: the plan cards are shrunk to postage stamps with illegible MONTHLY/FAMILY labels and are reordered 6-80-48, which breaks the original sequence and moves the featured yearly plan to the end. The supporting line and legal text are crammed into the right column at near-unreadable size, but the logo, headline, cards and CTA still read left to right. B has the same tiny, reordered cards. Its logo has shrunk to an illegible speck, the oversized CTA sits jammed against the top-right edge and outweighs the headline, and the subtitle, cards and legal text are stacked tightly in the centre column, so it reads as more disjointed.
